Good luck!

notes.title: Sep 6 2023 Update - 8 New Levels
notes.notes:
🧩 New Content
https://i.imgur.com/ikqkt73.png

 The Towers of Hanoi upgraded - 5 Discs
 Lights Out - Basic, 3x3 Building
 Sliding Puzzle - Basic, 3x3 Grid
 Chess Peace - 14 Bishops (must not attack)
 Bridge Crossing - Self Destructing Bridges
 Lights Out - Advanced, 4x4 Building
 Chess Domination - 3 Queens, 5x5 Board
 Sliding Puzzle - Advanced, 4x4 Grid

A fair warning: Some of the levels are fairly difficult 😀

💾 Save Progress

Your progress is now saved, so you if you stop at, say, Level 5, you don't need to complete levels 1-4 again next time you play.

↩ Revisit previous levels
https://i.imgur.com/UdaAGky.png
You can choose to replay any level you previously unlocked / played.

💲 Switching to Paid

With this release we're switching to a paid model, which will allow us to continue adding more interesting and cool puzzles. We're planning to add a demo with the first few levels soon. You don't need to pay for the game if you already have it in your library.

🔮 Going Forward

Our plans for the future:

 more achievements
 more levels
 gameplay improvements and general polishing

❤️ A Big Thank You

❤️💛💙 Thank you for playing Puzzillion and for all your encouraging support. ❤️💛💙
